title: GOAL: bus reads return phantom task ids under concurrency (KeyError '' / None in worker threads)
spec: Goal container, 2026-09-24. In the luna-inbox daemon, worker threads crash intermittently in spawn.run_worker -> Pool() -> pool._load -> bus.read -> bus.get(r[0]) with KeyError('') (00:0x) and KeyError(None) (~11:xx); a spec review also failed "post_result failed: ''". The tasks table never contains such rows afterwards (checked read-only). bus.db() returns one sqlite3 connection shared by all threads (check_same_thread=False) and bus.read runs its select outside locked(), so concurrent statements on the shared connection can interleave. One task B1.
acceptance: B1 merged into goal/<this id> and the PR opened
